demo-life-v3-biography.万叶，英文名 Caspian，杭州长大，现在住北京。\n\n2016-09 至:
Caspian grew up in Hangzhou and now lives in Beijing.

2016-09 to 2020-06: Studied software engineering at Zhejiang University
Moved from the family home in Hangzhou to the Zijingang campus, where Caspian met Wang Lei and Li Na. For his graduation project, he built a campus event registration tool. His adviser Liu Jianguo asked him to learn how classmates organized events before designing a prototype and writing code.

2020-07 to 2023-02: Joined the Feishu team at ByteDance
Moved to Beijing after graduation to work on frontend development for Feishu. At first, he focused on delivering reliable pages. He later began joining user interviews and asking colleagues why they used documents and spreadsheets in particular ways.

2022-03: Settled into life in Beijing
Moved to a rented apartment in Haidian with a shorter commute. He bought a sturdy desk, learned to cook on weekends, and began setting aside time to visit family in Hangzhou. Zhou Lin helped review the rental contract.

2023-03: Joined Moonshot AI as a Kimi product engineer
Joined Moonshot AI to turn model capabilities into products people could use every day. His work gradually grew to include user research, interaction prototypes, implementation, and feedback after launch. He began working with Zhang Min and Chen Wei.

2024-05: Started running every week with Wei Peng at Olympic Forest Park
At first, he could run only three kilometers without stopping. They now usually meet at Olympic Forest Park at 4 p.m. on Sundays. They adjust their pace to how they feel and keep running from becoming another performance target.

2025-11: Made room for life in the evenings and on weekends
After a busy stretch at work, he began reserving mornings for focused development and reducing last-minute evening meetings. He calls his parents in Hangzhou regularly and takes his camera out for walks on weekends.

2026-07: Began leading the Kimi Agent Workbench pilot
Started interviews with Liang Jia, with five complete records by September. The first round focuses on clarification, execution status, and resuming interrupted tasks. The pilot is planned for October 12; the product has not officially launched.

2026-08-16: Took a photography trip to Qingdao
Took the train to Qingdao with Gao Yuan. They spent an afternoon walking along the coast, photographing the sea under cloudy skies and laundry hanging beside the streets. Back in Beijing, he kept just twelve photographs and decided not to plan trips as lists of sights to check off.
